verdict.rationale: Discord documents a REST API reference covering authentication, webhooks, OAuth2 and the Gateway, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no evidence of a spec-driven interactive console. A static reference and llms.txt/markdown docs are adjacent features and do not meet the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
